cards.audioText: [You are at gate 221, with information C, ask for ATC clearance from Shanghai to Guangzhou.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在221号机位，通播C，请求从上海飞往广州的放行许可。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, CCA527, gate 221, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，国航527，221号机位，通播C，请求从上海飞往广州的放行许可。

cards.audioText: CCA527, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 10400m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 3515.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度10400米，离场后联系119.7，应答机3515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 10400m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 3515, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度10400米，离场后联系119.7，应答机3515。

cards.audioText: [Now you are on taxiway Z4, you are ready to taxi and request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在滑行道Z4，你准备好滑行了，请求滑行指令。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, CCA527, taxiway Z4, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，国航527，Z4滑行道，准备好滑行了。

cards.audioText: CCA527, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，经由Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R. CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点，国航527。

cards.audioText: CCA527, follow the B727 on A7, you are No. 2.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，跟着A7滑行道上的波音727，你是第二个。
cards.referenceText: Follow the B727 on A7, No. 2, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟着A7滑行道上的波音727，第二个，国航527。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at the threshold of Runway 36R, ask Tower for takeoff clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在跑道36右的入口，向塔台请求起飞许可。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, CCA527, threshold of runway 36R, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，国航527，在跑道36右入口，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: CCA527, cleared for takeoff, caution, migrating birds in the vicinity of airfield.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，可以起飞，注意，机场附近有候鸟。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 36R, thanks for caution, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36右，感谢提醒，国航527。

cards.audioText: [You just took off, passing 600m, contact departure.]
CCA527, Departure, radar ident, climb to 3000m, expedite passing 2100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，离场，雷达识别了，上3000米，加速爬升至2100米。
cards.referenceTextZh: 上3000米，加速爬升至2100米，国航527。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at cruising level, the thunderstorm is detected in front of you. You want to make a 15 miles deviation to the east of the current track from Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达巡航高度，前方检测到雷暴，你想在广州区调内从当前航路上东偏航15海里。]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA527, (10400m maintaining) request deviate 15 miles to the east due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航527，（正保持10400米）由于雷暴，请求东偏航15海里。

cards.audioText: CCA527, 15 miles deviation to the east is approved, direct to ATAGA when cleared of the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，同意东偏航15海里，脱离天气后，直飞ATAGA。
cards.referenceText: 15 miles deviation to the east is approved, direct to ATAGA when cleared of the weather, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意东偏航15海里，脱离天气后，直飞ATAGA，国航527。

cards.audioText: CCA527, descend to 4200m, when ready reach 4200m 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，下到4200米，在ATAGA前10海里下到4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, reach 4200m 10 miles before ATAGA, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到4200米，在ATAGA前10海里下到4200米，国航527。

cards.audioText: CCA527, increase your rate of descent greater than 2000ft per minute until passing 5700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，在通过5700米前，增加下降速度大于每分钟2000英尺。
cards.referenceText: Increase the rate of descent greater than 2000ft per minute until passing 5700m, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在通过5700米前，增加下降速度大于每分钟2000英尺，国航527。

cards.audioText: [Now you are established with the Guangzhou Approach, your assigned landing runway is 02R, you want to land on runway 02L.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你与广州进近建立联系，指定给你的跑道是02右，你想在跑道02左降落。]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CCA527, request land on runway 02L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，国航527，请求在跑道02左降落。

cards.audioText: CCA527, the runway 02L is not available due runway inspection. Runway in use 02R.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，由于跑道检查，02左跑道不可用，可用跑道为02右。

cards.audioText: [Now you are established on ILS runway 02R, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在建立跑道02右盲降，联系塔台。]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CCA527, established on ILS runway 02R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，国航527，建立跑道02右盲降。

cards.audioText: CCA527, cleared to land, expedite vacating runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，可以落地，落地后加速脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, (runway 02R), expedite vacating runway after landing, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，(跑道02右)，落地后加速脱离跑道，国航527。
